title: MXT case catalog
description: The list of cases that SHOULD exist, kept in the application repo and synced to the platform via POST /api/v1/apps/:app/catalog:sync. See docs/03-case-catalog.md. schemaVersion 1 catalogs (compass) are accepted; missing fields take defaults.

catalogFile.description: Server-side source identity supplied to catalog:sync. Repository files may omit it.

surface.description: Default surface for cases in this file. Decides whether runs go to the server runner pool or to a local machine.

executionMode.description: Free-text, informational. Kept for schemaVersion 1 compatibility.

coverage.description: Catalog-level capability posture. This is not a percentage and must not be collapsed into one coverage score.

id.description: <APP>-<SURFACE>-<DOMAIN>-<NNN>. Unique per app, not globally — compass keeps its existing LP-FE-* ids. Never reuse a retired id.

tracks.description: Which tracks this case participates in. Membership lives here, not in the spec's directory — that is what lets one spec serve both the functional and the review/demo track.

requirementRef.description: Requirement or story id. Without it, requirement coverage cannot be computed and must not be claimed.

coverageMode.description: The mechanism that provides evidence for this case.

automationState.description: Declared implementation posture. Runtime execution remains an independently observed fact.

_steps.description: Human-readable export aid emitted by the platform; executable step evidence belongs to run summaries.

retired.description: Soft delete. Keeps historical runs resolvable; the id stays reserved.
